templates.title: Primary Education Quality Improvement Program
templates.description: A comprehensive framework for improving learning outcomes in primary schools through teacher development and resource provision
templates.preview: Goal: Improve learning outcomes for primary school students through teacher training and resource provision.

content.title: Primary Education Quality Improvement Program
content.goal: Improve learning outcomes for 10,000 primary school students in underserved communities
goal_indicators: 20% improvement in literacy rates among target students within 2 years
15% improvement in numeracy scores within 2 years
assumptions: Government continues to support public education
Communities remain engaged in school activities

indicators: 80% of trained teachers apply new methods
Assessment completed for all target schools

templates.title: Digital Literacy for Rural Schools
templates.description: Program to equip rural students with essential digital skills through computer labs and trained instructors
templates.preview: Goal: Equip rural students with essential digital skills through computer labs and trained instructors.

content.title: Digital Literacy for Rural Schools
content.goal: Enable 5,000 rural students to achieve basic digital literacy
goal_indicators: 70% of students demonstrate basic computer proficiency
50% of students can safely navigate the internet
assumptions: Reliable electricity available in target schools

outcomes.description: Students regularly use computers for learning
indicators: Average 2 hours computer use per student per week

outputs.description: Computer labs established in target schools

templates.title: School Infrastructure Development
templates.description: Framework for enhancing learning environments through infrastructure improvements
templates.preview: Goal: Enhance learning environments through infrastructure improvements and facility upgrades.

content.title: School Infrastructure Development
content.goal: Provide safe and conducive learning environments in 50 schools
goal_indicators: All target schools meet safety standards
Student attendance increases by 15%
assumptions: Land rights are secured for construction

indicators: 100% of target schools have functional classrooms

templates.title: Community Health Education Initiative
templates.description: Program to improve community health outcomes through awareness campaigns and health worker training
templates.preview: Goal: Improve community health outcomes through awareness campaigns and local health worker training.

content.title: Community Health Education Initiative
content.goal: Improve health knowledge and practices in 100 communities
goal_indicators: 50% reduction in preventable diseases
80% awareness of key health practices
assumptions: Communities are receptive to health education
Health workers remain in their communities

templates.title: Youth Skill Development Program
templates.description: Comprehensive program to prepare youth for employment through vocational training
templates.preview: Goal: Prepare youth for employment through vocational training and soft skills development.

content.title: Youth Skill Development Program
content.goal: Enable 2,000 youth to gain employable skills
goal_indicators: 60% of graduates find employment within 6 months
80% of graduates report improved confidence
assumptions: Youth are motivated to complete training

activities.description: Identify high-demand skills in local market

templates.title: Women's Economic Empowerment Program
templates.description: Initiative to enhance women's economic participation through entrepreneurship support
templates.preview: Goal: Increase women's economic independence through entrepreneurship training and microfinance.

content.title: Women's Economic Empowerment Program
content.goal: Enable 1,000 women to establish sustainable livelihoods

templates.title: Community Forest Conservation Program

content.goal: Protect and restore 10,000 hectares of community forest

20% increase in forest cover in degraded areas

indicators: Maps completed for all target areas

templates.title: Rural Water Supply and Sanitation
